# ui::NativeNotification

Header: `winui/render/NativeHost.hpp`.

A Win32 message a hosted window sent its parent about itself (WM_COMMAND, WM_NOTIFY, WM_CTLCOLOR* and a scroll bar's or trackbar's WM_HSCROLL/WM_VSCROLL), handed to the element that owns the window by [NativeControl::handle_native_notification()](../controls/native-control.md#handle_native_notification). Windows only, like [NativeControlDesc](native-control-desc.md), and plain integers for the same reason: `wparam` and `lparam` are the message's own, and `result` is what the parent's window procedure returns when the element handled it (a brush for WM_CTLCOLOR*, a notification's return value).

Example: 
```cpp
class MyTrackbar : public ui::NativeControl
{
public:
    bool handle_native_notification(ui::NativeNotification& n) override
    {
        if (n.message != 0x0114 /*WM_HSCROLL*/)
        {
            return false;
        }
        position_changed(read_position());
        n.result = 0;
        return true;
    }

private:
    int  read_position() const;
    void position_changed(int position);
};
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `std::uint32_t` | `0` | The message id (WM_COMMAND, WM_NOTIFY, ...). |
| `wparam` | `std::uintptr_t` | `0` | The message's WPARAM. |
| `lparam` | `std::intptr_t` | `0` | The message's LPARAM. |
| `result` | `std::intptr_t` | `0` | What the parent returns when the element handled it. |
